data.name: Riftborn
data.detailed_description:
ONE GALAXY. BILLIONS OF CHALLENGERS. ONE WISH.

Riftborn is a fast-paced tactical arena roguelite set in the war-torn Riftbelt, where fighters from across space and time are pulled into the Collector’s Trial—a deadly championship that promises glory, fame, or even the rewriting of fate… if you survive.

You are one of them. A Riftborn.

Thrown into a brutal, escalating gauntlet, you command a growing squad of strange and powerful fighters. Every battle is a test. Every decision, a gamble. Each pickup, ally, or summon can turn the fight—or end your run.

⚔️ Core Gameplay Features

Tactical Brawls, Streamlined
Short, high-stakes battles built for momentum. Think fast. Adapt faster. Survive.

Summon Chaos
Call in unpredictable allies mid-battle and collect Moonstones to unleash Titans that can flip the fight instantly.

Endless Training Mode
Learn every unit, combo, and mechanic in a frictionless practice mode designed to sharpen instinct.

🏆 The Collector’s Championship

This isn’t just survival—it’s a series.
Seven matches. One winner.
First to four wins takes the crown.

You might sweep. You might go to Game 7.
Either way, the pressure builds every round.

Most fail. Some rage quit. A rare few endure.
Their names echo through the Rift.

🧩 Key Features

  • Tactical Arena Combat – Fast, intense battles that reward timing and positioning

  • Permadeath Pressure – Lose your units, and the run ends

  • Team Synergy – Combine allies, Titans, and playstyles

  • Competitive AI – Opponents adapt and challenge every match

  • Procedural Chaos – Pickups, fights, and outcomes change every run

  • Rift Ledger Lore – Discover the myth of Zor Luna and the Collector

  • Respawn Camera – Watch your allies continue the fight while you wait

🌱 Developer Note

Crafted by a solo developer at Moonrift LLC, Riftborn is a long-term Early Access project built to evolve over time, with the community as part of the journey.

data.short_description: Dash through chaos. Collect powerful pickups. Outrace the Collector and take control of the arena. Call savage dinosaurs, deadly robots, unruly beasts, and cuddly plush into battle in this roguelite. Titans and Champions surge from the Rift, flipping the battlefield instantly.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-4160 or AMD FX-4300
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 750 Ti or Intel HD 4600 (integrated)
  • DirectX: Version 11

Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
